patches.summary: create/quick/from-line/edit send the API's canonical `created` field instead of `date`.
patches.reason: Expensify ignores `date` on /RequestMoney, so every expense landed as today. `created` is what sync reads back.
patches.validated_outcome: Live create with --date 2025-11-17 read back with created=2025-11-17, not today.

patches.summary: auth login --from-chrome reads the freshest www.expensify.com authToken from Chrome (by last_update_utc, includes WAL).
patches.reason: A fresh login leaves stale authToken rows behind; selecting by value length grabbed an expired one, and a not-yet-checkpointed token lives only in the WAL sidecar.
patches.validated_outcome: doctor reports 'Session valid' immediately after a fresh browser login.

patches.summary: expense bulk files a list of expenses in one Expense_Create request with --dry-run.
patches.reason: Per-row sequential creates were fragile; a single request is the reliable shape.

patches.summary: expense delete auto-resolves the IOU reportID + reportActionID required by /DeleteMoneyRequest.
patches.reason: DeleteMoneyRequest with only transactionID returns jsonCode 200 but deletes nothing; it needs the IOU report action reference.
patches.validated_outcome: Live delete by transaction-id returned 21 onyx updates and the expense was gone.

patches.summary: Client surfaces in-body jsonCode 407 (HTTP 200) as a clear re-auth error instead of an empty success.
patches.reason: Expensify returns HTTP 200 with jsonCode 407 on session expiry, so sync silently reported 'Synced 0' instead of an auth error.

patches.summary: Dry-run prints the form-encoded request body (authToken masked) instead of nothing.
patches.reason: Bodies are application/x-www-form-urlencoded; the JSON-only printer silently showed no fields.

patches.summary: Honor explicit --reimbursable=false; close rate-limiter TOCTOU; bind LIMIT as a parameter; robust cookie domain-hash strip and PKCS#7 padding verification.
patches.reason: Findings from automated review (Greptile) on the library PR.
